subject.title: fix(validation): repair handles tracked workspace self-links

question: Should repair validation treat the narrowly matched tracked workspace self-links in this PR as trusted stable references?
rationale: The patch is technically well supported, but it deliberately changes a fail-closed validation boundary, and repository policy reserves that acceptance decision for a human.

options.title: Approve the narrow exception
options.body: Accept the tracked-link, tracked-manifest, exact-package-name boundary and merge after confirming the current head and checks.

options.title: Keep recursive fail-closed hashing
options.body: Decline the exception and pursue a different target-preparation design that removes or normalizes workspace links before validation.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow exception
recommendation.body: Accept the tracked-link, tracked-manifest, exact-package-name boundary and merge after confirming the current head and checks.
